remarks: Ideally situated in the desirable Springdale section of Stamford, this charming home offers convenient access to the train and everything Stamford has to offer. Upon arrival, you're welcomed by a spacious front porch, perfect for relaxing or entertaining. Step inside to a warm and inviting interior where the living room flows seamlessly into the dining area, with a beautifully renovated kitchen located at the rear of the home. The main level features two comfortable bedrooms and an updated full bath. Outside, the backyard provides an ideal setting for gatherings and outdoor enjoyment. Additional highlights include abundant storage with a walk-up attic and a full basement with laundry. Move right in and start enjoying all this home has to offer.
